programs.name: Computer Science (Bachelor of Science major) BSc
programs.a_level_offer: GCE A-levels: CDD (7 points) is UWA's equivalent of ATAR 70, the Bachelor of Science minimum (A-level points table: CDD=7, CCC=9, BCC=10, BBB=12, ABB=13, AAB=14, AAA=15).
programs.ib_offer: IB Diploma total 24 is UWA's equivalent of ATAR 70, the Bachelor of Science minimum (IB table: 24=70, 27=80, 30=85, 32=90, 35=94, 36=95, 40=98). English language competence: English A Literature or Language and Literature SL grade 4 or HL grade 3, Literature and Performance SL grade 4, or English B HL grade 5.
programs.ap_offer: US High School Diploma plus AP: AP aggregate 6 equals ATAR 70 (AP table: 6=70, 9=80, 11=85, 13=90, 15=94, 17=98). Or SAT 1100 / ACT 20 equals ATAR 70 (SAT/ACT table: 1170/24=80, 1220/25=85, 1270/27=90) together with the US High School Diploma. Maths prerequisite in AP terms: Mathematics Methods = AP Calculus AB grade 3+; the SAT/ACT route lists 'No equivalent' for the maths subjects.
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics Methods ATAR, or Mathematics Applications ATAR with a mathematics unit taken in the first year; students without ATAR Mathematics take two first-year mathematics units (Handbook major MJD-CMPSC). IB equivalents: Mathematics Analysis and Approaches SL grade 4+ or Applications and Interpretations HL grade 3+ for Methods; Applications and Interpretations SL grade 4+ for Applications.
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT 0-120 scale: overall 82, speaking 20, writing 20, listening 17, reading 17. TOEFL iBT 1-6 scale: overall 4.5, writing 4, listening 3.5, speaking 3.5, reading 3.5.
programs.english_note: UWA minimum standard English language competence: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with no band below 6.0; PTE Academic 64 with no band below 60; TOEFL iBT 82 (writing 20, speaking 20, listening 17, reading 17) on the 0-120 scale or 4.5 overall (writing 4, others 3.5) on the 1-6 scale; Duolingo 125 (speaking 115, writing 125, reading 115, listening 110); Cambridge C1/C2 170 (speaking and writing 175, listening and reading 165). Page: https://www.uwa.edu.au/study/how-to-apply/pathways-and-eligibility/english-language-requirements
programs.notes: 2027 entry (Semester 1). Offers are stated as an ATAR with UWA's own equivalence tables for other qualifications: IB https://www.uwa.edu.au/study/how-to-apply/pathways-and-eligibility/international-baccalaureate ; GCE A-levels, US AP and SAT/ACT: https://www.uwa.edu.au/study/how-to-apply/pathways-and-eligibility/international-and-overseas-qualifications . UWA's tables are equivalence points, so a student needs at least the listed IB / A-level / AP / SAT-ACT value for the ATAR the course requires; the 2027 International Course Guide (https://www.assethub.uwa.edu.au/api/public/content/6c9d60476b3d4e75afe43f5efb9b9373?v=0781fb37) gives the same ATAR/IB pair for this course. The AP table states an aggregate but not the points per AP grade; only AP scores of 3+ count, at least 2 AP subjects are needed, and AP results must be reported by the College Board. SAT/ACT must be taken within two years of the US High School Diploma, and a US High School Diploma (Year 12 English grade B, ACT English 25 or SAT English 600) is the English route for US students. Fee is the 2027 annual fee for international onshore undergraduates from UWA's fee browser (https://fees.uwa.edu.au/Browse/BrowseCourses?feeType=INTUG&feeYear=2027) ; the 2027 course guide itself quotes 2026 fees. Semester 1 2027 application deadline for international applicants: 11 January 2027 ('All other countries'); applicants from a listed group of countries (for example Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Philippines, Sri Lanka, Vietnam) must apply by 28 December 2026 (https://www.uwa.edu.au/study/how-to-apply/international-applicants). Some courses have different dates. UWA has no single 'Bachelor of Computer Science' for first-degree students: Computer Science is a major (MJD-CMPSC, accredited by the Australian Computer Society) taken inside the 3-year Bachelor of Science (BP004, CRICOS 068914G), so the ATAR 70 is the Bachelor of Science minimum shown on that page. Major page: https://www.uwa.edu.au/study/courses/computer-science . Handbook (2026) prerequisite: https://www.handbooks.uwa.edu.au/majordetails?code=MJD-CMPSC . Separate 4-year Bachelor of Advanced Computer Science (Honours) needs a higher score (the 2027 course guide lists 90/32).

programs.name: Engineering (Honours) BEng(Hons)
programs.a_level_offer: GCE A-levels: CCC (9 points) is UWA's equivalent of ATAR 80, the Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) minimum (A-level points table: CDD=7, CCC=9, BCC=10, BBB=12). Prerequisites must also be met (see required subjects).
programs.ib_offer: IB Diploma total 27 is UWA's equivalent of ATAR 80, the Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) minimum (IB table: 24=70, 27=80, 30=85). English language competence: English A Literature or Language and Literature SL grade 4 or HL grade 3, Literature and Performance SL grade 4, or English B HL grade 5.
programs.ap_offer: US High School Diploma plus AP: AP aggregate 9 equals ATAR 80 (AP table: 6=70, 9=80, 11=85). Or SAT 1170 / ACT 24 equals ATAR 80 together with the US High School Diploma. Prerequisites in AP terms: Mathematics Methods = Calculus AB grade 3+; Mathematics Specialist = Calculus BC grade 3+; Chemistry = AP Chemistry grade 3+; Physics = AP Physics 1 and 2 (or Physics B) grade 3+. The SAT/ACT route lists 'No equivalent' for these subjects, so AP (or other subject results) is needed to meet them.
programs.required_subjects: Scaled score of at least 50 in Mathematics Methods ATAR, and at least 50 in one of Chemistry ATAR, Physics ATAR or Mathematics Specialist ATAR (all three recommended; up to two free electives can make up missing knowledge in first year). IB equivalents: Mathematics Analysis and Approaches SL grade 4+ (or Applications and Interpretations HL grade 3+) for Methods; Chemistry or Physics SL grade 4+ / HL grade 3+; Analysis and Approaches HL grade 3+ for Specialist.
